PRESIDENT'S ORDER 16 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
16 OF 1985
HOUSES OF
PARLIAMENT AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (ELECTIONS) (EIGHTH AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary. Part I, 6th March, 1985]
No. F. 17(3)/85-Pub.--The
following Order, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information.
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order :-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the Houses of Parliament and
Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Eighth Amend ment) Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 4, P.
(P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977.--In the Houses of Parliament and Provincial
Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 [P. (P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977], hereinafter
referred to as the said Order, in Article 4, after clause (3), the following
new clause shall be inserted, namely :-
"(3-A)
Where a non-Muslim seat reserved in the National Assembly for any minority
remains unfilled such seat shall be filled by a non-Muslim woman to be elected
on the basis of proportional representation by means of a single transferable
vote by the electoral college consisting of the non -Muslim members of the
Assembly."
3. Amendment of Article 5, P. (P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977.--In
the said Order in Article 5,-

"aalim" means a Muslim scholar wish high qualifications in reli gious

(b)
